archetypes.label: All-Courter
archetypes.blurb: Balanced game across serve, return, and rally length. The complete game.

archetypes.label: Power Server
archetypes.blurb: Big serve, weaker on return. Lives or dies by the first delivery.

archetypes.label: Pure Return Specialist (1st-serve neutralizer)
archetypes.blurb: Clearest expression of this archetype in the dataset. Elite at neutralising big first serves. Forces returners into rallies.

archetypes.label: Counterpuncher (2nd-serve attacker)
archetypes.blurb: Punishes second serves disproportionately. Forces servers to take risks.

archetypes.label: Steady Return Specialist (1st-serve neutralizer)
archetypes.blurb: Higher serve consistency than the adaptive version. Elite at neutralising big first serves. Forces returners into rallies.
